dictionary.title: Reasoning engine
dictionary.footer: The engine uses only the capabilities allowed to the speaker's role and asks for confirmation through the current path for sensitive actions.
dictionary.native_missing: The native engine is not available on this server.
dictionary.emergency_off: The emergency switch is on: the engine stays off until it is removed from the server configuration.
dictionary.mode_off_hint: The engine neither watches nor acts: only the current path answers.
dictionary.mode_shadow_hint: The engine decides next to the current path without acting and measures how much it agrees.
dictionary.mode_active_hint: The engine runs valid plans and falls back to the current path when it cannot complete them safely.
dictionary.forced_hint: Activated by force before the gate was passed.
dictionary.force: Force activation even with the gate closed
dictionary.reason_gate_too_few_days: More days of shadow observation are needed.
dictionary.reason_gate_too_few_samples: More requests comparable with the current path are needed.
dictionary.reason_gate_low_agreement: Agreement with the current path is below the threshold.
dictionary.reason_gate_too_many_invalid: There are too many invalid plans.
dictionary.inferred_hint: Contracts to tune have cautiously inferred effects: declare them in the tools for more precise plans.
dictionary.traces_hint: Decisions do not contain the request text: only goal, capabilities, cost and comparison.
dictionary.settings_gate_hint: Active mode opens on its own only when all these thresholds are met.
